unharnessed.meaning: Every duty, condition and qualification kept accurately, including the Selective Service line, PIV, the 18-semester-hour note and the AFGE unit: "Only postgrad study beyond the first year (18 semester hours) counts for the GS-9."
unharnessed.sense: Fits: "part-time work gets counted pro rata", "all the program goals get ticked off", "the chance to work from home" for telework.
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural plain Australian English ("postgrad", "Have a look at"), though "You've gotta" is a little forced in a job ad and "Specialized Experience" keeps US spelling beside "specialised".
unharnessed.register: More plain-English rewrite than level-3 Aussie: little idiom beyond "ticked off" and "gotta" ("Understand and properly use the technical resources available for, and tied to").
unharnessed.tone: Still a clear, official job ad, made friendlier.
unharnessed.flow: Reads easily: "If you get picked at a lower grade level, you'll get the chance to learn how to do all of these duties".
unharnessed.variety: Little slang to vary; "gotta" twice, "Have a look" twice.
unharnessed.essence: Plainly the NARA vacancy, structure intact.

yarn.meaning: All requirements kept accurately; additions are colour ("no worries", "Your experience can come from any paddock").
yarn.sense: Exact: "learn the whole box and dice", "running the show" for leading others, "new starter", "right to work", "tick these boxes", "on your CV".
yarn.authenticity: Sounds like an Australian HR officer talking: "Get your head around what the customers need", "Know your way around the technical gear".
yarn.register: Level 3: idiom throughout without losing the ad's function; no swearing.
yarn.tone: Still an official vacancy notice, warmer in voice.
yarn.flow: Reads smoothly: "Keep the work on track, whether you're going it alone, pulling your weight in a team or running the show".

engine.meaning: "Must be U.S. Battlers or U.S. Nationals" turns the citizenship requirement into nonsense; the rest is the original verbatim.
engine.sense: "Battlers" for Citizens, "the paddock(s) covered by the position" for field(s): wrong senses.
engine.authenticity: Bolt-ons on untouched text: "Bugger me, go through a Personal Identity Verification", "Bloody hell, specialised experience".
engine.register: Essentially untranslated ("The following are the duties of this position at the GS-12"); far under level 3.
engine.tone: An official ad with random oaths, which jar badly.
engine.flow: Readable because it is the original, but the inserted oaths break sentences.
engine.variety: Two oaths and two swaps; nothing to vary.
engine.essence: Recognisably the ad, but with its key eligibility line garbled.

unharnessed.quote: You've gotta pass a background check.
unharnessed.original: Must successfully complete a background investigation.
unharnessed.why: "gotta" is a stock casualism, a touch off in an ad.

unharnessed.quote: Specialized Experience: For the GS-09, you need one year of specialised experience
unharnessed.original: Specialized Experience: For the GS-09, you must have one year of specialized experience

unharnessed.quote: Understand and properly use the technical resources available for, and tied to
unharnessed.original: Understand and properly use the technical resources available for, and associated with

yarn.quote: Your experience can come from any paddock
yarn.original: The experience may have been gained in either the public, private sector or volunteer service
yarn.why: "paddock" is a slightly forced image here.

engine.quote: Must be U.S. Battlers or U.S. Nationals.
engine.original: Must be U.S. Citizens or U.S. Nationals.

engine.quote: in the paddock(s) covered by the position
engine.original: in the field(s) covered by the position
engine.why: "paddock" for field of study is the wrong sense.

engine.quote: Bugger me, go through a Personal Identity Verification
engine.original: Go through a Personal Identity Verification
engine.why: Oath bolted onto an official requirement.

engine.quote: The following are the duties of this position at the GS-12.
engine.original: The following are the duties of this position at the GS-12.

summaries.unharnessed: Accurate and readable plain-English version, lighter on Aussie than the brief asks.
summaries.yarn: A natural, accurate and fully level-3 retelling of the ad.
summaries.engine: The original ad with a few wrong word swaps and oaths, one of them garbling eligibility.
